info.name: NEXUS - API Gateway
info.description:
Spring Cloud Gateway — central entry point for all public NEXUS API traffic. Handles JWT validation, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and routing. The fallback endpoints are returned by circuit breakers when downstream services are unavailable. Port: 8080

Note: In normal usage you call services THROUGH the gateway at port 8080 (not directly on each service port). These fallback endpoints are what you receive when a circuit breaker opens.

request.description:
Returned when the Transaction Service circuit breaker is open.

Response 503: {
  error: 'TRANSACTION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
  message: 'Transaction service temporarily unavailable. Your account has NOT been charged. Please try again in 30 seconds.',
  retryAfter: 30,
  timestamp: String
}

Returned when the Account Service circuit breaker is open.

Response 503: {
  error: 'ACCOUNT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
  message: 'Account service temporarily unavailable. Your account data is safe. Please retry shortly.',
  retryAfter: 15,
  timestamp: String
}

Returned when the AI Assistant circuit breaker is open. AI is non-critical — standard banking features still work.

Response 503: {
  error: 'AI_ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE',
  message: 'AI assistant is temporarily unavailable. You can still use all standard banking features at /api/v1/',
  alternativeEndpoints: { accounts, transactions, ledger },
  timestamp: String
}
Login through the API Gateway (port 8080). The gateway routes this to nexus-identity-service. JWT is returned in response; refresh token set as HttpOnly cookie.
Get accounts through the API Gateway. Gateway validates JWT and injects X-User-Id header before routing to nexus-account-service.
Initiate transfer through the API Gateway. Circuit breaker active — returns fallback if transaction service is down.
